benefits.body: Guests decide to book long after your host stand goes quiet. Cekat.AI's agent answers reservation requests, operating hours, and location questions the moment they arrive, day or night, so a diner planning tonight's dinner or next week's party gets a confirmation instead of silence, and your team walks in to handled chats.

benefits.title: Menu, Promo, and Price Questions Answered Instantly
benefits.body: "Is there a vegetarian option?" "How much for the set menu?" "Any promo tonight?" Cekat.AI answers in natural language, understanding intent rather than matching keywords, so hungry guests get certainty in seconds and decide to come in, instead of scrolling to the next place that replied faster.

benefits.title: Event and Catering Inquiries Never Slip Through

faq.q: How does Cekat.AI help restaurants and F&B businesses?
faq.a: It answers guest chats instantly 24/7 on WhatsApp, Instagram, and web chat, handling reservations, menu and promo questions, operating hours, and event inquiries, while organizing every booking and order in one platform. Your front-of-house team focuses on guests in the room, not a buzzing phone.

faq.q: Can the AI handle table reservations and bookings?
faq.a: Yes. Cekat.AI answers reservation requests around the clock and, through API integration with your booking system, can confirm and reschedule inside the chat. Every booking is captured with full context, and automated reminders go out before the date to reduce no-shows.

faq.q: Can customers place food orders through the chat?
faq.a: Yes. Cekat.AI auto-creates orders from the conversation, including items, customer details, shipping cost via cek ongkir, and a payment QR. A guest goes from question to paid delivery or takeaway order without ever leaving the chat, and nothing gets retyped by hand.

faq.q: What about event, catering, or private-booking inquiries?
faq.a: High-value event and catering inquiries are captured into a CRM card automatically, with the full conversation attached. The AI answers first questions instantly at any hour, and your events team follows up on qualified leads instead of scrolling a crowded inbox for the ones that matter.

faq.q: Which channels can a restaurant connect?
faq.a: WhatsApp (official Business API), Instagram DM, Facebook Messenger, and website live chat, all flowing into one inbox with a single interaction history per guest. A diner who DMs on Instagram then messages on WhatsApp never has to repeat themselves.

faq.q: What results have F&B businesses seen with Cekat.AI?
faq.a: Holywings Group moved from handling event, booking, and pricing inquiries manually to 100% chat coverage 24/7 after implementing Cekat.AI, with up to +70% conversion, higher guest satisfaction, and more revenue from inquiries that previously went unanswered.

faq.q: Does the AI keep up during a busy dinner rush?
faq.a: Yes. The AI answers every incoming chat instantly no matter how many arrive at once, so response time stays flat when volume spikes. Anything complex escalates to your team with the full conversation attached, and AI working hours keep coverage running after your staff log off.

faq.q: How long does setup take for a restaurant?
faq.a: Building the AI agent takes around five minutes, paste your menu, prices, outlet details, and SOPs into the knowledge base and it starts answering accurately. No coding is required; Cekat.AI describes it as being as easy as briefing a new CS admin.

faq.q: Can Cekat.AI send promos and follow-ups to guests?
faq.a: Yes. Broadcast campaigns reach guest segments through the official WhatsApp Business API, weekend promos, new-menu launches, event reminders, built from activity and order history, with automated follow-ups based on each guest's behavior instead of a manual list.
